scope: G4 localized-tool H1 verification for canonical ms/uk locales
expected: G4 must assert each localized tool H1 against the same authoritative tool-SEO resolver used by production rendering.
actual: The runtime test asserted TOOL_SEO_NAMES only. Newly supported ms/uk routes could therefore omit the H1 localization assertion when the legacy dictionary had no corresponding entry.

changes: Replace the legacy TOOL_SEO_NAMES test oracle with getAuthoritativeToolSeoName().
Resolve the tool from the route family using getToolConfig().
Keep the H1 assertion active for every non-English tool route where the production resolver returns a reviewed/localized name.

verificationRequired: G4 localization runtime suite on fresh SHA
regression of canonical locale and SEO contracts
